Application.name: Snowflake

AttributeDefinition.name: name
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's unique identifier name

AttributeDefinition.name: login_name
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's login name

AttributeDefinition.name: display_name
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's display name in the Snowflake web interface

AttributeDefinition.name: first_name
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's first name

AttributeDefinition.name: last_name
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's last name

AttributeDefinition.name: email
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's email address

AttributeDefinition.name: days_to_expiry
AttributeDefinition.Description: Number of days until the user account expires and user can't log in

AttributeDefinition.name: comment
AttributeDefinition.Description: Additional information related to the user account

AttributeDefinition.name: disabled
AttributeDefinition.Description: User account disabled status

AttributeDefinition.name: must_change_password
AttributeDefinition.Description: When enabled, the user must change their password on their next login

AttributeDefinition.name: snowflake_lock
AttributeDefinition.Description: User's lock/unlocked status in Snowflake

AttributeDefinition.name: default_warehouse
AttributeDefinition.Description: Default warehouse for the user

AttributeDefinition.name: default_namespace
AttributeDefinition.Description: Default database namespace prefix for the user

AttributeDefinition.name: default_role
AttributeDefinition.Description: Role used in the user-initiated Snowflake session

AttributeDefinition.name: default_secondary_roles
AttributeDefinition.Description: Set of secondary roles used during user's login session

AttributeDefinition.name: owner
AttributeDefinition.Description: Owner of the user

AttributeDefinition.name: roles
AttributeDefinition.Description: All roles directly assigned to the user

AttributeDefinition.name: name
AttributeDefinition.Description: Role's unique identifier name

AttributeDefinition.name: is_default
AttributeDefinition.Description: Indicates if the role is a default role

AttributeDefinition.name: is_current
AttributeDefinition.Description: Indicates if the role is a current role

AttributeDefinition.name: is_inherited
AttributeDefinition.Description: Indicates if the role is inherited by another role

AttributeDefinition.name: owner
AttributeDefinition.Description: Owner of the role

AttributeDefinition.name: comment
AttributeDefinition.Description: Additional information related to the role

AttributeDefinition.name: roles
AttributeDefinition.Description: List of child roles

AttributeDefinition.name: privileges
AttributeDefinition.Description: Direct privileges assigned to the role
